perks.name: Between Poles
perks.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.
perks.exact:
Light Weapon Kills grant a stack of Light Polarity for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Light Polarity grants +8 | +16 | +24 | +32 | +40 Grenade Stat.

Kinetic/Dark Weapon Kills grant a stack of Dark Polarity for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Dark Polarity grants +8 | +16 | +24 | +32 | +40 Melee Stat.

Scoring a Non-Alignment Matching Weapon Kill removes all stacks.
ANY Light Polarity --> Dark Alignment Weapon Kill --> x1 Dark Polarity and x0 Light Polarity.

perks.name: So Very Thin
perks.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.
perks.exact:
Light Weapon Kills grant ~16% Grenade Energy.
Kinetic/Dark Weapon Kills grant ~16% Melee Energy.

Upon scoring a Light Weapon Kill within 10 seconds of scoring a Dark Weapon Kill, or vice versa:
Resist x3 (40% [7.5%] DR) for 5 seconds.
Refreshable by retriggering the effect.

Both effects can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.
